text: At its meeting held December 16 and 17, 2021, City Council re-appointed the following two public members to the CreateTO Board for a term of office from January 1, 2022 to June 30, 2023 and until successors are appointed • Ron Carinci, re-appointed as Chair • Marcie Zadjeman These appointment follow Ron and Marcie's last term which ended on December 30, 2021.
The Board of Directors of CreateTO received the item for information.
